returned_by: Claude blind re-read and batch read, 2026-09-28
drift: Batch drift report (T0001-T0013, read together): the rows have converged on one template. About 20 of 28 say 'X was recorded before/after Y', add a child's drawing or sticker, and end with 'the only completed count is <returned objects>, not people'. Each row is fine on its own, but a player who finds three of them has found the same clue three times, and the world sounds like one clerk. The containment rows are all timestamp-and-form jokes and the agricultural rows are all 'water total before source'; a blind reader sorts them by that alone. Keep the tone (one human detail beside one institutional one), but vary it: different human stakes (not always a child), different institutional blind spots (not always a count), clues that are mostly an arrangement of objects with a short note or none, and other spots where both sides can use them (ground, vehicle, mailbox, corpse), not only furniture.

rows.note: A blind re-read (5 independent reads, a different model, told nothing) never named the rival, so the row is one-sided. The lean should come from where the clue is placed and from one detail; the rest must leave the rival reading genuinely live. Rework title, body and if needed pieces; keep place, spot, lean and axioms. See the drift report at the top of this file.

row.body: The outgoing count was signed before the last bed emptied. A child's sticker is on the first-aid kit; the form's only completed field is the case number, not the passenger.
row.title: Transfer complete, bed still occupied
row.gloss: A transfer record closes before its listed bed is empty while a kit remains with the paperwork.
row.rival_reading: A field exposure could produce interrupted transfers and hurried kit logs; the mismatch alone does not show that officials caused or hid a containment failure.

row.body: The bandage and full water bottle were logged against a field worker before the source box was filled in. The worker's lunch break was marked late; the only complete count is for used wraps.
row.title: Source field left blank
row.gloss: A field worker's supplies are logged before a source entry is completed.
row.rival_reading: An intake during road restrictions could document supplies before tracing their source; a field worker's delayed meal may reflect an ordinary response disruption.
